Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the interstate compact on mental health.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to adopting the interstate compact on mentalhealth; adding a new chapter to Title 7 RCW; and declaring anemergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that providing for thesurrender of persons who have been found not guilty by reason ofinsanity, and who have fled from a state where they were under an orderof detention, commitment, or conditional release or their return to thestate from which they fled, consistent with the interstate compact onmental health, will promote public safety.

The definitions in this section applythroughout this chapter unless the context clearly requires otherwise. (1) "Flight" or "fled" means a departure from a state in which aperson was under detention, commitment, or conditional release due toa finding of not guilty by reason of insanity. (2) "Governor" means the governor of a state or the executiveauthority of the District of Columbia.
The governor of this state may arrest andtransfer a person, in this state, who has been found not guilty byreason of insanity and who has fled from detention, commitment, orconditional release.

The governor of this state may demand thereturn to the state of Washington any person who has been found notguilty by reason of insanity and who has fled from detention,commitment, or conditional release in this state.

Except as otherwise specifically provided inthis chapter, state and local officials and the courts shall have thesame powers and follow the same procedures in effecting the provisionsof this chapter as are set forth in the uniform criminal extraditionact, chapter 10.88 RCW.

Except as otherwise specifically provided inthis chapter, persons subject to arrest, surrender, or return underthis chapter have the same rights provided to persons accused orconvicted of crimes under the uniform criminal extradition act, chapter10.88 RCW.

If any provision of this act or itsapplication to any person or circumstance is held invalid, theremainder of the act or the application of the provision to otherpersons or circumstances is not affected.
This act applies retroactively to anycircumstances that occurred or demands for surrender or return thatwere made before the effective date of this act.
Sections 1 through 8 of this act constitutea new chapter in Title 7 RCW.

This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of the SHB 2533 p. 2 state government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
